about_the_game:
Trails is a challenging puzzle game where you must lead sandships through a crumbling, post-apocalyptic wasteland. Each ship follows a unique trail, and once a course is set, there’s no turning back. Avoid collisions, navigate treacherous terrain, and ensure every ship reaches its destination. With limited space, tight constraints, and growing complexity, every move counts.

Supply Outposts

Scattered across the dunes remote villages and communities depend on precious supplies for survival. To solve each level, you must chart efficient routes, pick up the needed cargo and meet every village’s needs. No ship can cross the same path twice, and every stop must serve a purpose.

Juggle Resources

Each Sandship can carry only one item at a time - whether it’s a crucial resource, a key to unlock new routes, or a rare power-up that bends the rules in your favor. Careful planning and strategic exchanges are essential to keeping the convoy moving.

Hazards of the Wasteland

The desert is unforgiving. Shifting sands, deadly traps, and frenzied drones threaten to derail your progress. The deeper you venture, the more perilous the journey becomes. Precision and foresight will be your greatest allies.

Can you chart the perfect course and bring hope to the wasteland?
